description: Embark on a 5-day culinary journey through Tokyo, exploring vibrant street food, mastering Japanese cooking, and indulging in delicious local specialties. This itinerary focuses on immersive food experiences and comfortable luxury accommodation.

accommodation.amenities: restaurant, spa, pool, airport shuttle, breakfast included

days.title: Arrival and Ginza Street Food Exploration
days.description: Arrive in Tokyo, check into your hotel, and immediately dive into the city's culinary scene with a street food tour in Ginza.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Experience the bustling streets and hidden culinary gems of Ginza. What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and an appetite. What to eat: Sample various local street foods like yakitori, takoyaki, and sweet treats. Good to know: This tour is a great introduction to Tokyo's diverse food culture.

days.title: Morning Cooking Class and Evening Market Crawl
days.description: Learn to cook traditional Japanese dishes in the morning, then explore a vibrant night market and tapas scene in the evening.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef
activities.notes: What you'll see: Learn authentic Japanese cooking techniques from a local chef. What to bring: Your enthusiasm for cooking and a camera. What to eat: Enjoy the dishes you prepare, such as sushi, tempura, or ramen. Good to know: This hands-on experience offers insight into Japanese home cooking.

What you'll see: Discover the lively atmosphere of Tokyo's night markets and hidden tapas bars. What to bring: Cash for small purchases and an open mind for new flavors. What to eat: Taste a variety of small plates and local snacks. Good to know: This tour is perfect for experiencing Tokyo's nightlife and casual dining scene.

days.title: Premium Street Food and Cultural Immersion
days.description: Enjoy a premium street food tour in Shinjuku, followed by a historical walking tour to experience Tokyo's rich culture.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Street Food Walking Tour — Premium Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Explore Shinjuku's diverse food scene with a curated selection of premium street eats. What to bring: Comfortable shoes and a camera for memorable food shots. What to eat: Indulge in high-quality street food, potentially including gourmet snacks and local delicacies. Good to know: This tour offers a more refined street food experience.

What you'll see: Discover ancient temples, traditional gardens, and historic neighborhoods. What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and a water bottle. What to eat: While not a food tour, you might find small local snacks available. Good to know: This tour provides a fascinating glimpse into Tokyo's past and cultural heritage.

days.title: Afternoon Cooking Class and Evening Tapas
days.description: Participate in an afternoon cooking class to further hone your Japanese culinary skills, then enjoy another night market and tapas crawl.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Learn to prepare different Japanese dishes in an afternoon setting. What to bring: Your culinary curiosity and a desire to learn. What to eat: Enjoy the delicious meal you've prepared with your group. Good to know: This class offers another opportunity to deepen your understanding of Japanese cuisine.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Night Market & Tapas Crawl — Evening Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Experience the vibrant evening atmosphere of Shibuya's food scene. What to bring: An adventurous palate and comfortable shoes for walking. What to eat: Sample a variety of small dishes and drinks from local vendors and bars. Good to know: This crawl is a great way to discover new favorite snacks and drinks.

days.title: Relaxation and Departure Preparation
days.description: Enjoy a relaxing wellness and spa experience before preparing for your departure from Tokyo.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Indulge in a rejuvenating spa experience. What to bring: Swimsuit if required and personal toiletries. What to eat: Light refreshments may be available at the spa. Good to know: This is a perfect way to relax and unwind after several days of exploring.
